en.title: It Is Well with My Soul
en.author: Horatio G. Spafford
stanzas:
When [D]peace, like a river, at[G]tendeth my [D]way,
When [D]sorrows like sea [E7]billows [A]roll;
What[D]ever my [D7]lot, Thou hast [G]taught me to [A]say,
It is [D]well, it is [A7]well with my [D]soul.

Though Satan should buffet, though trials should come,
Let this blest assurance control,
That Christ hath regarded my helpless estate,
And hath shed His own blood for my soul.

My sin—oh, the bliss of this glorious thought!—
My sin, not in part but the whole,
Is nailed to the cross, and I bear it no more,
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord, O my soul!

For me, be it Christ, be it Christ hence to live:
If Jordan above me shall roll,
No pang shall be mine, for in death as in life
Thou wilt whisper Thy peace to my soul.

But, Lord, 'tis for Thee, for Thy coming we wait,
The sky, not the grave, is our goal;
Oh, trump of the angel! Oh, voice of the Lord!
Blessed hope, blessed rest of my soul!

And Lord, haste the day when the faith shall be sight,
The clouds be rolled back as a scroll;
The trump shall resound, and the Lord shall descend,
Even so, it is well with my soul.
en.chorus:
It is [D]well [D7]with my [G]soul,
It is [D]well, it is [A7]well with my [D]soul.

notes: Text from Timeless Truths, which prints the full six-stanza text (its own cited sources are hymnary.org and the Cyber Hymnal) and whose stanza 1 agrees word-for-word with hymnary's representative text apart from hymnary's lowercased pronouns. Most hymnals print four stanzas (1, 2, 3, 6 here) — hymnary's representative text has four — but stanzas 4–5 are Spafford's and the Cyber Hymnal/Timeless Truths text carries them, so per FORMAT's no-trimming rule all six ship. Refrain is the source's two lines, without the echo parentheses some hymnals add. Tune VILLE DU HAVRE (Philip P. Bliss, 1876); meter as hymnary lists it. Key: the hymnal key is D-flat (Timeless Truths score); D and C are each one semitone away and FORMAT's preference order picks D. Chords are Bliss's harmonization simplified for guitar, keeping the characteristic V-of-V (E7) under "billows roll".
